purpose: functional verification of machine file routes on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a file goes in and comes out the same, and the guest's digest of it agrees
directories are made, and with a user they and the file are that user's
a file written over a longer one is exactly the new one
a file the guest made comes out, by a path with spaces and more in it
what cannot be done is refused, each with a status that says whose it is

detail.a directory's name: path names a directory; give the file's own name
detail.no path: Failed to deserialize query string: missing field `path`
detail.a file that is not there: Script error: reading /tmp/files/absent: No such file or directory (os error 2)
detail.reading a directory: Script error: reading /tmp/files: it is a directory
detail.writing under a file: Script error: creating the directory of /tmp/files/text/below: File exists (os error 17)
detail.a user for a read: user is for a write: a file is read as root
detail.a user the guest has not: Script error: owning /tmp/files/x: no user nobody-here in this sandbox
detail.a file out that is too large: Script error: /tmp/files/too-big is 68157440 bytes, over the 67108864-byte limit
detail.a file in that is too large: Failed to buffer the request body: length limit exceeded

cases.name: nothing goes in or out of a stopped machine
